'''Druug''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who worked as a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and owned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Profit (pirate ship)|''Profit'']]. 

==Biography==
During his career as a pirate he worked with the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Pillage]]'', owned by fellow pirate [[Larken]], and another pirate vessel named ''[[Trust Me]]'', in an [[Ambush near Darknon Station|attempt]] to capture the [[Helix-class light interceptor|''Helix''–class light interceptor]], ''[[Kizbon's Box]]'' based on a tip from a female named [[Sahr]]. The three vessels waited near the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], [[Darknon Station]], under the cover of a [[Ion storm/Legends|magnetic storm]] in order to ambush their target, who they believed to be unarmed. When the ''Box'' arrived the three ships moved into attack it, but much to Druug's horror they soon discovered their mark was not quite as harmless as they'd been led to believe, secretly possessing armaments including [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedos]]. The ''Box'' used the torpedo's to destroy the ''Trust Me'' while Druug cursed at Larken over the [[Comlink/Legends|comm]], however before the pirate could finish what he was saying the ''Profit'' also came under fire, [[Death/Legends|killing]] Druug.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Druug first appeared in [[1995]] the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for [[West End Games]], ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]] and included two short stories to illustrate some of the ships mentioned. Druug appeared in one of these, titled "''Kizbon's Box''" which gave no information as to what era it was set in.<ref name="ABGTAS" />
